sentences.text: Jixiangornis lacked teeth like later avialans but retained a long tail unlike modern birds.
Its long forelimb measured 131% of its hindlimb length, suggesting it possessed some aerial ability.
The animal is known from only one complete but juvenile fossil specimen.
This fossil was discovered in the Yixian Formation near Beipiao City in western Liaoning, China.
Studies by Hartman et al. (2019), Cau (2020), and Wang et al. (2020) concluded Jixiangornis was a member of the family Jeholornithidae but not a synonym of Jeholornis.
Jixiangornis lived between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago during the Barremian to Aptian stages.
